name: Don't Kill Rumble
summary: Welcome to DKR a chaotic 6-player party brawler where you bounce, punch, and outwit your friends (or enemies) in explosive arenas full of traps and nonsense. Don’t die. Try not to cry. Blame your controller. It’s all part of the RUMBLE.
